findings.message: The unconditional preemption-disable guard prevents voluntary blocking, allowing a blocked task to continue executing. On SMP with configUSE_TASK_PREEMPTION_DISABLE enabled, call vTaskPreemptionDisable(NULL) followed by vTaskDelay(10). vTaskDelay calls prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList, which removes the current task from its ready list and inserts it into a delayed list, then requests a context switch through taskYIELD_WITHIN_API. The new guard in vTaskSwitchContext only sets xYieldPendings and skips taskSELECT_HIGHEST_PRIORITY_TASK whenever xPreemptionDisable is set, so the delayed task remains current and returns from its delay without waiting. The guard must distinguish preemption from switches required by blocking, suspension or deletion.
